facts.fact: Interlignes reports Algeria's health minister said the electronic medical record was designed and developed entirely by engineers of the health ministry's information systems directorate.
Interlignes reports the health ministry launched a national deployment plan for the electronic medical record, aiming at over 2,500 health structures in all 69 wilayas.
Interlignes reports the first phase selected over 200 trainers from ten pilot wilayas to pass the system on to health establishments.
Interlignes reports the health minister opened the first training week of the national electronic medical record deployment plan in Algiers.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health, information systems directorate

DZA.note: The document is about the electronic medical record, not routine aggregate reporting to the ministry.

facts.fact: Interlignes reports the health minister said the electronic medical record was entirely designed and developed by engineers and staff of the ministry's information systems directorate.

DZA.note: The document says nothing on schools.
